'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament Greg Shaw LS Rebel Strike Team''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed]]
* '''Username:''' stealthblind
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
